title: CubeSat structural study
summary: Investigating a hybrid composite and aluminium satellite structure.
overview: An academic structural-design study combining CFRP panels with aluminium rails.
constraints: The design considers launch loading, stiffness, mass and the interfaces between dissimilar materials.
contribution: University work in structural simulation and design; the case describes the proposed structure and analysis scope.
approach: The study uses FEM to investigate the hybrid structure and its loading conditions, alongside manufacturing constraints.
results: The previous portfolio describes structural analysis of the proposed chassis. This page makes no claim of a manufactured or flown satellite.
limits: The final structural results and the status of topology optimization should be distinguished. A proposed additive process is not evidence of fabrication.
